boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Houston
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and convenience stops with published late or round-the-clock availability on campus and in the surrounding Houston area.

cards.title: Market Next at Technology Bridge
cards.subtitle: University of Houston campus
cards.notes: Use the checkout-free campus market for packaged snacks, drinks, sandwiches, and microwavable food when other counters have closed.
cards.evidence_claim: UH states that Market Next at Technology Bridge operates 24 hours a day and sells snacks, coffee, beverages, microwavable items, and sandwiches.
cards.source_title: UH Opens Touchless, Checkout-Free Retail Store
cards.access_notes: UH’s published description says the market operates 24 hours a day; confirm building access rules before heading over.

cards.entity_name: Farmer's Fridge at University of Houston Student Center South
cards.title: Farmer’s Fridge at Student Center South
cards.subtitle: 4800 Calhoun Rd, main floor
cards.notes: Find the refrigerated vending location beside Houston Street Subs for a quick prepared-food pickup without relying on counter service.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour prepared-food vending stop in Student Center South.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmer's Fridge lists its University of Houston Student Center South location as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: University of Houston - Student Center South | Farmer's Fridge
cards.access_notes: The operator lists this location as open 24 hours daily; it is on the Student Center South main floor beside Houston Street Subs.

cards.title: Denny’s on Southmore
cards.subtitle: 2316 Southmore Blvd, Houston
cards.notes: Choose the Southmore diner when you need a sit-down or takeout option; its location page lists all-day breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner near the Museum District side of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's lists its 2316 Southmore Blvd restaurant as open 24 hours and offering round-the-clock breakfast, lunch, dinner, and takeout.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s official page lists it as open 24 hours every day, with walk-ins and takeout available.

cards.title: Denny’s on Gulf Freeway
cards.subtitle: 6969 Gulf Freeway, Houston
cards.notes: Keep this Gulf Freeway diner in mind for a full meal at any hour; the official page lists breakfast, lunch, dinner, and takeout.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock diner along the Gulf Freeway corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's lists its 6969 Gulf Freeway restaurant as open 24 hours, with breakfast all day plus lunch, dinner, and takeout.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists open-24-hours service on every day of the week.

cards.title: IHOP at Gulf Freeway and Woodridge
cards.subtitle: 6888 Gulf Fwy, Houston
cards.notes: Use the Gulf Freeway IHOP for dine-in, takeout, curbside pickup, or delivery when a late meal needs a clearly published schedule.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour IHOP with multiple ordering options.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its 6888 Gulf Freeway restaurant as open 24 hours every day and identifies dine-in, takeout, curbside pickup, delivery, and late-night food.
cards.source_title: IHOP Breakfast in Houston, TX on 6888 Gulf Fwy
cards.access_notes: IHOP’s official location page lists Monday through Sunday as open 24 hours.

cards.title: Whataburger at I-45 and Woodridge
cards.subtitle: 6888 Gulf Fwy, Suite 200, Houston
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for a late pickup; the location page separates its 24-hour drive-thru schedule from dine-in and delivery hours.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour drive-thru stop on the Gulf Freeway.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists the drive-thru at its 6888 Gulf Freeway location as open 24 hours daily; dine-in runs later on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Whataburger at 6888 Gulf Fwy Ste 200 Houston, TX
cards.access_notes: Official hours list the drive-thru as 24 hours daily; dine-in is listed until midnight most days and 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: Whataburger on Telephone Road
cards.subtitle: 6402 Telephone Rd, Houston
cards.notes: Plan this as a drive-thru pickup rather than a late dine-in stop, since the published drive-thru hours run around the clock.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour drive-thru option on Telephone Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists the drive-thru at 6402 Telephone Road as open 24 hours every day, while dine-in is listed from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Whataburger at 6402 Telephone Rd Houston, TX
cards.access_notes: Official hours show a 24-hour drive-thru daily; do not rely on this location for late indoor seating.

cards.title: IHOP on Southwest Freeway
cards.subtitle: 2515 Southwest Fwy, Houston
cards.notes: Use this 24-hour diner for a full late-night menu with dine-in, takeout, and delivery options listed by the operator.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour IHOP in the inner-Houston freeway network.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP's Houston location directory lists the restaurant at 2515 Southwest Freeway as open 24 hours with dine-in, takeout, delivery, and late-night food.
cards.source_title: IHOP Restaurant Locations in Houston, TX
cards.access_notes: IHOP’s official Houston directory marks the 2515 Southwest Freeway location as open 24 hours.

cards.title: Denny’s on South Loop West
cards.subtitle: 3332 S Loop W, Houston
cards.notes: Use the South Loop diner for a round-the-clock meal or takeout option; the operator lists breakfast, lunch, and dinner service.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner on the South Loop corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's Houston location directory lists the restaurant at 3332 S Loop W as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Denny’s official Houston directory labels the 3332 S Loop W restaurant “Open 24 Hours.”

cards.title: IHOP at 8607 Southwest Freeway
cards.subtitle: 8607 Southwest Fwy, Houston
cards.notes: Consider this Southwest Freeway location when traveling by car and needing published overnight availability for a sit-down or pickup meal.
cards.short_summary: Another officially listed 24-hour IHOP in Houston.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP's Houston location directory lists the restaurant at 8607 Southwest Freeway as open 24 hours with dine-in, takeout, delivery, and late-night food.
cards.source_title: IHOP Restaurant Locations in Houston, TX
cards.access_notes: IHOP’s official Houston directory marks the 8607 Southwest Freeway location as open 24 hours.
